note: First Hawaiian Bank, with branches on Guam and in the Northern Mariana Islands, offers its United card to residents of Guam and the CNMI only: 18.00% a year on purchases (variable with the US prime rate), and 99 dollars a year after a first year free, which is introductory and not written. Its disclosure was published on 1 May 2024, the one the bank's page links today. Bank of Guam's own cards state no rates or fees outside its application portal, which asks for a login.
